Review content, target track/time and optional source rectangle, then Add. Enter commit freeze; complete one atomic addition or retain the unchanged draft and staged choices. Saved-video expansion with conflicting track settings does not insert. Named clips are copied into independent occurrences; a composed clip becomes one grouped object. No future library update changes this copy.

Select whole occurrences on one track. Show the active track, occurrence identities and applicable properties. Composition-wide range selection is a separate alternate. A grouped clip is selected and acted on as one object until Ungroup.

Trim within source and neighbor bounds. End extension pushes only the forward collision chain on this track; shortening can leave a gap. Preview and commit one undoable edit; invalid input or cancellation preserves the draft. Start moves its source boundary and timeline start together with timeline End fixed, stopping at time zero, source bounds or the previous clip; minimum duration is one frame. A group keeps parts hidden by inward trim and can restore or extend edge-source content on outward trim.

Save all four tracks, their output rectangles and audio, and video-owned occurrences with source rectangles and audio. Commit freeze applies; failure retains draft, selection, insertion context and entered name.
